title: Pentagon says only three UAP videos exist, then another branch admits more

tellings.quote: after some of these videos were released uh the Pentagon said yeah there's no more videos just those three videos

plain: After some military videos of UAP, unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs, were released, the Pentagon said there were no more videos beyond those three, and then another branch admitted it had more, the journalist Michael Shellenberger tells Michels, crediting the records researcher John Greenewald Jr. He tells it as a sign that the Pentagon's denials on the subject cannot be taken at face value.
